entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: RPG Maker XP technical tileset atlas, NOT an illustration or a finished room. The exact input atlas is the edit target. Original canvas 256 x 576 pixels, an 8-column by 18-row grid of 32 x 32 tiles. Preserve EVERY tile at EXACTLY the same grid cell, every object outline, every original color, all transparent empty cells, and every existing red-X placeholder cell. This is a drop-in atlas replacement: moving or merging any object breaks the game. Keep walls, two plants, statue, signs, mats, patterned blue floor, light blue cabinet segments, book displays, angled shelves and lower shelf/sign fragments IDENTICAL in layout, size, count and orientation. Enhance ONLY fine existing surface detail and gradient cleanliness within each tile. The red X marks and their white squares are reserved cells: copy those unchanged, do not interpret or remove them. Preserve sharp straight boundaries and repeatable tile edges. No new objects, furniture, labels, letters, text, borders, shadows, perspective, lighting or palette changes. Do not compose this into a room; keep it a technical sprite atlas. No crop, zoom, pan, padding changes or grid changes. Target 256 x 576 exactly; if generating larger keep the exact 4:9 aspect ratio and proportional 8x18 grid. Transparent original areas must remain genuinely transparent.
